newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open flat to $5 higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open flat to $5 higher.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open unchanged to $5 a tonne higher on Thursday, in line with gains overnight in London, traders said.
London cocoa futures were a touch higher in thin, rangebound trading early Thursday. LIFFE July cocoa was up two stg at the midday break, to 1,022 stg, after ranging from 1,025 to 1,018 stg.

Wednesday, New York cocoa futures ended higher in light turnover, boosted by speculative and local short-covering. July rose $14 a tonne, to close at $1,466, after trading from $1,469 to $1,445. Second-month September ended $15 higher, at $1,496, while the back months gained $16 to $17.
On the charts, traders pegged July near-term resistance at $1,473-$1,478. On the downside, support was seen at $1,455.
Fundamentally, Japan's April cocoa bean imports totalled 5,747 tonnes, up 33.5 percent from the same month last year, Finance Ministry data showed Thursday.
